description: This is a Swift source file containing an extension to `OnboardingView`, providing UI layout and interaction logic for an onboarding interface in a macOS application using SwiftUI. It defines view components, navigation controls, and state management for the onboarding process.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main UI layout for the onboarding view, including icons, page content, navigation, and appearance setup.

methods.name: activePageIndex
methods.description: Calculates the current page index based on a given cursor, ensuring it is within valid bounds.

methods.name: reconcilePageForModeChange
methods.description: Updates the current page to reflect mode changes, trying to keep the same or next suitable page.

methods.name: navigationBar
methods.description: Constructs the navigation controls including back button, page indicators, and next button.

methods.name: onboardingPage
methods.description: Provides a scrollable container for onboarding content views.

methods.name: onboardingCard
methods.description: Creates a styled card view with padding, background, and shadow.

methods.name: onboardingGlassCard
methods.description: Creates a transparent, glass-like styled card with overlay border.

methods.name: featureRow
methods.description: Builds a feature information row with icon, title, and subtitle.

methods.name: featureActionRow
methods.description: Builds a feature row with an actionable button.

methods.name: featureRowContent
methods.description: Internal method for composing the content of feature rows, including optional action buttons.
